# Pixel Tip Calculator

A pixel-themed tip calculator built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Works offline in any modern browser.

## Features

- Enter bill amount and number of people
- Choose tip percent (10%, 15%, 20%) via accessible buttons
- Displays tip per person and total per person
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Pixel-art aesthetic with blocky borders and stepped shadows
- Full keyboard support and visible focus states

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in a web browser. No server or build step required.

## Controls

- **Bill amount**: type a number (decimals allowed)
- **Tip percent**: click a button or focus one and press Enter/Space
- **Number of people**: type a whole number (defaults to 1 if invalid)
- Results update automatically as you type or change the tip

## Accessibility

- All inputs have visible labels
- Tip buttons use `aria-pressed` to indicate selection
- Focus outlines are visible on all interactive elements
- Results are announced via `aria-live`

## Files

- `index.html` – structure
- `styles.css` – pixel theme and layout
- `app.js` – calculation logic

## Constraints

- No external assets, fonts, or network requests
- No inline event handlers
- Uses system monospace font stack for pixel feel
